items.title: Scripts can close a window for good
items.text: `ghoztty +close --force` closes a pane or window without asking, skips the undo window, and ends its process right away. Scripts that clean up finished task windows no longer leave them behind.

items.title: No more silent no-op closes
items.text: When a window is waiting on its "Close Terminal?" question, `+close` now says so and fails instead of reporting success while the window stays open.
